title: Bismillah and Alhamdulillah: Dhikr in Every Moment
summary: A child learns through repetition and association. Link 'Bismillah' to eating and 'Alhamdulillah' after it, and 'Alhamdulillah' upon sneezing; small words that, by habit, become a tongue ever-remembering for a lifetime.
try_this: This week: Say 'Bismillah' before every meal in a cheerful voice, and encourage your child to repeat it with you.
reflection_prompts: Which dhikr has your child started repeating?
When does he say it spontaneously?
